data_description.model: Which Mistral model to use. Ministral-8b is recommended for home automation commands: fast, cost-effective and great at instruction-following. Ministral-14b is new (Dec 2025) and the strongest of the small edge models. Note: on a free/Experiment-tier API key, the pricier models (Medium, Large) are the ones most likely to be rate-limited or rejected — see the note next to each model below.
data_description.prompt: Instructions for the AI. Supports Jinja2 templates — for example, the HA instance name via ha_name, or the current date via now(). See the README for the full list of variables.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Select which Home Assistant APIs the AI can use to control your devices. 'Assist' exposes the same entities as the built-in voice assistant.
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum length of the AI response in tokens.
data_description.web_search: When enabled, the AI can search the web for up-to-date information. Uses Mistral's Conversations API (beta). Requires a model that supports agents (mistral-small-latest, mistral-medium-latest or mistral-large-latest). See 'Web search routing' below — the 'Always search' option sends every request through the slower Conversations API and disables device control for those turns.
data_description.web_search_mode: 'Let the model decide' (recommended): the AI searches only when it decides it needs to, and can still control your devices in the same turn. 'Always search': every request goes through the Conversations API — slower, and device control does not work on those turns.
data_description.web_search_trigger: Optional. Comma-separated phrases, for example 'search for, look up, google'. When set, these take precedence over the routing mode: only commands starting with one of these phrases search the web (the phrase itself is removed from the query), and all other commands never search. Leave empty to let the routing mode decide.
data_description.tts_mode: Stream: low-latency SSE WAV with sentence-level pipelining. Batch: single mp3 request, higher latency but smaller responses cache well. The tts.speak service always uses batch.

options.ministral-3b-latest: Ministral 3B — fastest & cheapest, simple commands (free-tier friendly)
options.ministral-14b-latest: Ministral 14B — new, strongest small model (free-tier friendly)
options.mistral-small-latest: Mistral Small — balanced speed & quality (free-tier friendly)
options.mistral-medium-latest: Mistral Medium — needed for web search; ⚠️ paid tier, often rate-limited on free API keys
options.mistral-large-latest: Mistral Large — most capable; ⚠️ paid tier, often rate-limited on free API keys
